command -v /usr/bin/time || true; cat > /app/tmp/make_lookup_stress.py <<'PY'
import importlib.machinery,importlib.util,json,time,resource
l=importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('s','/app/submit/run');sp=importlib.util.spec_from_loader(l.name,l);s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);l.exec_module(s)
fib=[(i <<117,128,i&65535) for i in range(2048)]
m=s.Model(fib);cuts=list(range(0,128,8))+[128]
st,u=m.build(cuts);im=s.make_image([10**9]*16,32,cuts,st,u)
print('nodes',sum(len(stg['nodes']) for stg in st),'edges',sum(len(n['edges']) for stg in st for n in stg['nodes']),'used',u)
addresses=[s.canonical_ipv6(((i%2048)<<117)|(i*98989)) for i in range(20000)]
req={'op':'lookup','image':im,'addresses':addresses}
with open('/app/tmp/lookup_stress.in','w') as f:f.write(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('bytes',len(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))))
# Worst active prefix lengths, in a separate request file.
base=int('123456789abcdef0011223344556677',16)
fib2=[]
for le in range(129):fib2.append((s.trunc(base,le),le,le))
r=12345
while len(fib2)<2048:
 le=r.randrange(1,129) if False else (len(fib2)*37)%128+1
 v=s.trunc((r.getrandbits(128) if hasattr(r,'getrandbits') else 0),le)
# deterministic nested + adjacent unique prefixes
seen={(v,le) for v,le,h in fib2}
i=0
while len(fib2)<2048:
 le=i%128+1;v=s.trunc(((i*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)<<64 | (i*0x100000001b3)) & ((1<<128)-1),le)
 if (v,le) not in seen:seen.add((v,le));fib2.append((v,le,i&65535))
 i+=1
m=s.Model(fib2);cuts=[0,32,64,96,128];st,u=m.build(cuts);im=s.make_image([10**9]*4,32,cuts,st,u)
addresses=[s.canonical_ipv6(base ^ (i&0xffff)) for i in range(20000)]
req={'op':'lookup','image':im,'addresses':addresses}
with open('/app/tmp/lookup_lengths.in','w') as f:f.write(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('second bytes',len(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))),'lengths',len(set(le for v,le,h in fib2)))
